servinfo.title: Maintenance Schedule under Normal Driving Conditions (for Europe)

item.ptxt: The intervals should be determined based on odometer readings or months, whichever comes first.
The following table shows the service schedule up to 240,000 km (150,000 miles). Beyond 240,000 km (150,000 miles), perform the same maintenance services at the same intervals shown in the table.
This table shows the typical maintenance schedule.
The actual maintenance schedule, however, varies depending on vehicle specifications, so the typical maintenance schedule may not be applicable to some models.

Therefore, for the maintenance schedule that is specifically applicable to the vehicle being serviced, follow the relevant instructions in the “Periodic maintenance schedule” under “INSPECTION AND MAINTENANCE” section of the Owner’s Manual.

entry.ptxt:
Engine oil and engine oil filter *1 (R:
)
ACEA Standards or SUZUKI GENUINE OIL
Replace by following oil change request light or change oil message in instrument cluster.
If the light or message does not come on, replace every 20,000 km (12,500 miles) or 12 months.
Other than ACEA Standards or SUZUKI GENUINE OIL
Replace by following oil change request light or change oil message in instrument cluster.
If the light or message does not come on, replace every 15,000 km (9,375 miles) or 12 months.
First time only: Replace at 160,000 km (100,000 miles) or 96 months.
Second time and after: Replace every 80,000 km (50,000 miles) or 48 months.
Replace every 40,000 km (25,000 miles) or 36 months.
Inspect every 20,000 km (12,500 miles) or 12 months.
Replace every 40,000 km (25,000 miles) or 36 months.
Refer to Maintenance Recommended under Severe Driving Conditions (for Europe) schedule.
Inspect every 40,000 km (25,000 miles) or 24 months.

item.ptxt: “I”: Inspect, clean, adjust, lubricate or replace it if necessary
*1: For “Oil change request light” or “Information display”, refer to Oil Life Monitoring System Description .
*2: If SUZUKI super long life coolant (coolant color: Blue) is replaced with the other coolant, follow schedule for SUZUKI long life coolant (coolant color: Green).
